headline: Parag Milk Foods shares voting results of 34th Annual General Meeting
hook: Routine AGM resolutions pass at Parag Milk
summary: Parag Milk Foods has submitted the voting results and scrutinizer's report for its 34th Annual General Meeting held on September 29, 2026. Shareholders voted on standard resolutions presented during the meeting. The procedural filing completes the post-AGM compliance requirements for the company. Indian retail shareholders can note the successful conclusion of the annual meeting without contentious outcomes.
why_it_matters: Standard AGM compliance with no direct impact on stock price.
